notes.text: In Chagigah, Rav Bardala bar Tavyomi speaks in the name of Rav, as [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=784&lang=en) also records. The sentence continues at [the start of 5b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chagigah.5b.1). Sukkah names Rabbi Ami bar Tavyomi in a separate notice.
